head_commit.message:

The link telemetry emitter and the P4 testbed reaper read their manifests through a trust check (owned by root or by the reader, not writable by group or others) and act only on the exact process a manifest names, by argv and start time, instead of matching by name. A bring-up whose switch manifest cannot be written now fails. Exercise fixtures record the compile command of each build artifact.

workflow_runs.name: CI
workflow_runs.display_title: tests: exit on INT and TERM in suites that stub privileged commands

head_commit.message:
tests: exit on INT and TERM in suites that stub privileged commands

Three suites keep fake sudo, mnexec or iperf in a temp directory on PATH and
removed that directory in a signal handler that then returned. After INT or
TERM they kept running without the fakes, so later calls reached whatever
real command came next on PATH. The handlers now only exit, with 130 or 143,
and the EXIT trap does the cleanup.

The probe-stub closing check now tells a stub that was never installed from
one that was deleted while the suite ran.

head_commit.message:
kernel: carry P4 switch capabilities onto get_graph_data nodes (#14)

Each bmv2 switch node carries the capabilities object the proxy serves on GET /p4/switch_state, copied verbatim and absent whenever the kernel has nothing to copy; one proxy request per tick feeds both the capabilities and the liveness verdicts; the L4 differential allows the P4-only key and spec.py pins its type.

head_commit.message:
Merge feat/ndt-serve-gui-0927 (opus judge MERGE on 8c3047c7, after MERGE AFTER FIXES on fcd4f69a): ndt serve serves its own page

Adam's ruling H (2026-09-27): the GUI is a static page that ndt serve itself serves at /, /app.js and /app.css, same origin, no CORS. The token reaches the page through a one-time key in the URL fragment that serve prints at start (POST /session, Origin required to be this very origin, good once, --nonce-ttl s, 8 newest only); the page drops the fragment from the address bar as soon as it has read it. New reads GET /lab (plain status plus the claim, measuring and declared rows verbatim, claim_is_yours, measuring_is_nothing, busy) and GET /meta. dry_run is accepted only on writes that spawn, and returns the argv without running it. The confirmation strength per write is the server's confirm_policy; the page adds only the measuring rule. The job log is read every 2 s and stops when the job ends, when the view is closed, and while the page is hidden.

Judge B1 (fcd4f69a): an app start/stop under somebody else's claim was refused only by the page -- ndt's apps verbs check no claim -- so w_app now reads the claim inside the slot (_require_own_claim, 409 claim for another owner, none, stale or a `yours-x` owner); the preview still needs no claim. G-N1, G-N7, G-N8, G-N17 and the REPORT's numbers are fixed in the same round.

Test merge d09a4f17 (7746832e + 8c3047c7, tree aba2f7c7, this merge's): test_ndt_serve 74 OK, test_ndt_serve_cells 35 OK, test_ndt_serve_gui 40 OK, tests/browser/test_ndt_serve_page 5 OK under the guard and 5 skipped outside it, mutate_ndt_serve 150/0, mutate_ndt_serve_page 5/0, check_gate_anchors 122/122, check_process_by_name and check_test_tmpdirs clean, tripwire 0, tracked tree clean after the gates. Queued after this merge, on a branch of its own: test_claim_note_reaches_ndt_as_one_argv_element goes red under a TMPDIR longer than about 55 characters (a note built from two absolute temp paths against a 200-character cap).

Merge fix/stale-suites-0927 (opus judge MERGE on 1d5180ce, after MERGE AFTER FIXES on d2a9d641): three suites red in every environment and in CI's L1 groups. test_start_bg_log_rotation keeps only start_bg's own decision (a non-empty log rotated, an empty one and a first start not), retargeted to O-4's stamped generations; the rotation contract stays test_stack_log_rotation's (13 checks -> 5, the accounting in the suite). test_gate_exit_code_not_tee is hermetic: a fully synthetic t008_poll fixture (plot_figures.RAW via NDT_SAMPLING_RAW_DIR, which round.env now unsets), case 1b asserts the fixture was read (ratio 1.0000), case 2 asserts the verdict line and not only rc 2 -- it had passed for the wrong reason (UNRUNNABLE rc 2). test_l1_shell_scoring group C renders every echo/printf through the lane's own shell_summary (the runtime scorer read all 12 flagged suites correctly; the static last-echo heuristic was the wrong side) and holds the failure-path shapes by rule (2a) same-line exit and (2b) a later bare exit; the renderer fails closed; mutate_l1_shell_scoring gains a green-baseline refusal (every KILLED there had been vacuous) and named-rule kills (20/0). Known limitations recorded: a branch summary followed by a bare exit. Stacked test merge d32738b0 (same tree): trunk's three red (6/2/12), heads 5/0, 8/0, 96/0, gates 9/0 and 20/0, anchors 121/121, tripwire 0, in a worktree with no 08-20 raw. CI prediction: the start_bg and l1_scoring groups clear (14 -> 12); not_tee still SKIPs in CI (no PY_PLOT).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

head_commit.message:
Merge fix/hb-followups-r3-0927 (opus judge MERGE on c22d1300): the r2 judge's R-N1/R-N2/Q2 -- 08's mutant and baseline trees are built by one ltree that links only p4_proxy/proxy_agent and p4_proxy/venv, so no lab-state knob (p4_proxy/mininet/*_override) is inside a tree a mutant can write; the gate refuses before any mutation if ltree_leaks names a way out, with a whole-p4_proxy control (red first c0cef392: rc 2, both exits named). 07's live L1 poll is an argument (30 s when the live path passes none), never L1_POLL_S from the caller (red first a435d24e: 'judged 3 polls 2'); L7-28/L7-29. The redfirst harness keeps its output and tells a trailing line after SELF-TEST PASS apart. Mutants 195/0 and 174/0. Test merge ebc6808c (same tree): 07/08 self-tests PASS, anchors 120/120, 174/0, 195/0, the main checkout's knobs unchanged, tripwire 0. Open NOTEs: l6_plain's 30 s default is run by no self-test (R3-N4); st_l6_inherited orphans its poll loop (R3-N3); green() counts lines with wc -l (R3-N1).

head_commit.message:
Merge fix/live-p1-common-5e-nolab-0927 (opus judge MERGE on be2ad2d2, after MERGE AFTER FIXES on c03130fe): test_live_p1_common.sh can no longer reach a live fabric -- on 09-26 17:55Z its 5e cells (hosts h1..h3, sudo/iperf real in drive()) ran a 2 Mbit/s iperf between a live 06 arm's hosts. The suite now always runs under a fake fabric (a PATH ps listing mininet:h1..h4 at pids above pid_max, FIRST, so a real host never wins host_pid -- the judge's F1, red first with an unprivileged decoy) with sudo/mnexec/iperf/iperf3 on PATH that record and refuse; 5e and 13 noctrl use zz1..zz3 and are pinned to the namespace refusal (rc 2); section 14 fails on any call no stub caught, with two controls. Red first: trunk's suite made 4 sudo mnexec iperf calls and said '163 checks, 0 failed'. Mutants M42-M44, T1/T2 (45 mutations, 0 survived; 4 controls). Test merge d3683aeb (same tree): both red-firsts, 169/0, 45/0, tripwire 0. Open (NOTEs): six suites send read-only lab probes that act on a live answer; four suites are red under the mandated shim+guard environment; T1/T2 anchors are invisible to check_gate_anchors.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
